name: Roblox Performance Pack

game_settings: Render Distance: Reduced via in-game slider
os_settings: Set Roblox process priority: Above Normal (not High)
GPU preference: High Performance for RobloxPlayerBeta.exe
Background app restrictions: Enable for Roblox
driver_settings: GPU Power Management: Maximum Performance (Roblox only)
background_processes: Close browser tabs (Chrome/Edge can consume significant RAM)
Disable Discord hardware acceleration or use compact mode
Close RGB control software after setup
optiplay_tools: FPS Unlocker integration guide (external tool - user responsibility)

does_not_modify: Network adapter settings (beyond standard TCP optimization)
revert_steps: Windows Power Plan: Back to Balanced
GPU preference: Reset to System Default for Roblox
Process priority: Back to Normal via Task Manager
warnings: FPS Unlocker is a third-party tool - use at own discretion (not provided by OptiPlay)
Some Roblox games override graphics settings server-side
Low graphics settings may affect gameplay visibility in certain games
Performance varies greatly by specific Roblox game (complex games will always lag on low-end systems)
notes: Roblox is CPU-bound in many scenarios. Upgrading from HDD to SSD provides significant load time improvements. This preset focuses on reducing background interference and optimizing Windows for Roblox's specific engine requirements.
